title: Pilot advisors
description: A white band with a centred heading and lede over three hairline-framed columns, one per advisor: the name and their background set on flat highlighter-style tags (lime, butter yellow, cyan), a two-paragraph quote, and a cut-out portrait in the bottom-right corner over a soft diagonal tint of the same colour. Ends on a violet statement with a violet brush stroke. On phones the columns stack in one bordered box.
notes: tag colours are chart-4 (lime), highlight (yellow) and accent (cyan)
